name: weird-eagle-in-chains
_comment: ARM B — 'The Eagle in Chains'. A deliberate attempt to get NAPOLEON CAPTURED. He leaves the Seat alone with his 10,000 Guard, marches AWAY from every French corps (who are ordered to sit still and watch), and throws himself at Mack's 52,000, then deeper into Austria. NP-4 says capture is the only road to the Eagle in Chains and that encirclement is the way. Questions: can the player actually lose their sovereign? What does the game DO when it happens — is captivity legible, is peace leverage real, can a captured emperor still be commanded (a NP-V P1 that was fixed — this re-checks it), does the aura decay show on screen, and does the game remain playable afterwards?
